verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on per-note version history, restoring earlier versions, or a bin or trash for recovering deleted notes. Automatic background backups and import/export are related data-safety features, not version history or restore, so they earn no credit. Version history is a fair question for a note-taking app, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view a note's version history and restore earlier versions or recover deleted notes
